_readme: TEMPLATE for <runtime root>/config/backup_targets.json — the dest declaration
cosmos_backup_mounts reads. It is NOT read from here; copy it to the config role
and fill each dest with an ABSOLUTE path Keith chooses.
Nothing in COSMOS guesses a dest from a well-known drive letter. An absent row
is NO_DEST; a dest that is not a directory is DRIVE_NOT_MOUNTED (DriveFS signed
out, OneDrive missing, or the Seagate ES.3 ST3000NM0033 not yet installed).
A dest on the SAME volume as the source is SAME_VOLUME — that is the gap this
identity is optional. When present it is CONTENT, not existence:
sentinel       a JSON file on the dest whose fields must match 'expect'
model          requires an injected probe (stdlib cannot read disk model)
SECRETS: gdx/odx/es3 all REFUSE a scope containing key material (unencrypted).
D:\R2Cloner is FORBIDDEN as a dest.
The dest values below are EMPTY on purpose — filling them is Keith's door.

local._readme: F-43 P0 daemon dest (cosmos_local_clock). Must be a different volume from source. Empty dest is NO_DEST / NO_SOURCE; live/backups is not a dest. identity is optional CONTENT (volume_serial / volume_label / sentinel / model), not existence of the dest dir — a swapped disk at the same letter is IDENTITY_MISMATCH. excludes is per-target (unioned with LOCAL_DEFAULT_EXCLUDES; cannot drop live/config or *.lock from this unencrypted dest). A .lock is a writer fence, not data; live/ledger/authority.jsonl stays in scope; live/config credentials never copy to an unencrypted dest.
